# HappyTokenizer

> Free online tokenizer and token cost calculator for 140+ LLMs — GPT, Claude, Kimi, Qwen and GLM. All tokenization runs in your browser; your text never leaves your device.

## Main tools

- [Tokenizer](https://happytokenizer.com/): Real-time token counting, token visualization and cost estimation for 140+ models
- [Chat Tokenizer](https://happytokenizer.com/chat): Tokenize full chat conversations with per-message and system-prompt cost breakdowns
- [Model Catalog](https://happytokenizer.com/models): Every supported model with encoding, context window and per-million pricing

## Popular model tokenizers

- [GPT-6 Astra](https://happytokenizer.com/models/gpt-6-astra)
- [GPT-5.6 Sol](https://happytokenizer.com/models/gpt-5.6-sol)
- [GPT-5](https://happytokenizer.com/models/gpt-5)
- [Claude Opus 5](https://happytokenizer.com/models/claude-opus-5)
- [Claude Sonnet 5](https://happytokenizer.com/models/claude-sonnet-5)
- [Kimi K3](https://happytokenizer.com/models/kimi-k3)
- [Qwen3.8 Max](https://happytokenizer.com/models/qwen3.8-max)
- [GLM-5.3](https://happytokenizer.com/models/glm-5.3)
- [GPT-5.1 Codex](https://happytokenizer.com/models/gpt-5.1-codex)
- [GPT-OSS-20B](https://happytokenizer.com/models/gpt-oss-20b)

## Notes

- OpenAI models use real tiktoken vocabularies (o200k_base, cl100k_base and friends), so counts match API-side token usage.
- Claude, Kimi, Qwen and GLM use each vendor's real tokenizer.
- Pricing shown per 1M tokens, matching published API rates.
